description: One Home Assistant automation in the current syntax (triggers, conditions, actions) for a kind of house sensor, from Sensor House: leak-sensor, freeze-sensor, humidity-sensor, garage-door-sensor, sump-pump-plug, sensor-watchdog. Give your own entity ids and thresholds as options, or leave them out for placeholders to rename. The same code writes the recipes on the site, and a test parses every one.

options.description: The recipe's settings by key, for example { "sensor": "binary_sensor.water_heater_leak" }. A value that is not valid keeps the default. The keys for each device are listed in the answer.

name: home_assistant_recipe
title: Write a Home Assistant automation for a sensor
